listing.name: Final Fantasy III (3D remake, Steam/GOG) / OpenFF3 Enhanced (ausnick2001)
listing.summary: An enhanced version of Final Fantasy III (3D remake) on PC, built on the foundations of Zerratar’s OpenFF. Features include FFX style turn-based battles, a full customisable dungeon minimap, upscaled textures, encounter rate modifiers, a more aesthetically pleasing battle menu, easier to read fonts, and more!!
